diagnosis.narrative: The series shows no clear long-run trend. Seasonality is strong (period 52): a repeating cycle explains much of the movement. Predictability is middling — structured signal and irregular noise are balanced. The series reads as stationary by the ADF/KPSS tests. Across validation windows the model ranking is unstable (Kendall tau -0.123), which favours a robust combination.

Test a robust median over pool3 to see if it beats the current leader.
Test a robust median over the more stable pool2 to see if it improves over the current leader.
Test a deterministic DBA over the most stable pool1 to see if it can beat the current leader.
Test a robust single model that might outperform NaiveMovingAverage – THETA.
Test a trimmed mean over all 19 models with 20% trimming – a robust, low‑variance combiner that hasn’t been tried yet.
Test a weighted combination on the most stable pool (pool3) using inverse error weights to see if it beats the current leader.
Test a deterministic DBA over pool2 to see if a different subset improves over the current leader.
Test a DBA over pool3 to see if a different subset yields a better robust average.
Test a different best_single model (ARIMA) to see if a single model can beat the current leader.
Test a weighted combination using inverse_error on pool2 to see if a different pool improves over the current leader.

decision.justification: Selected 'best_single NaiveMovingAverage' (an agent proposal) as the best of 22 backtested attempts, score -0.0005. Series context: trend strength 0.0734 and seasonal strength 0.7579; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau -0.123); 3 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.604.
